items.title: Return signed Nutzungsvertrag
items.quote: Bitte senden Sie uns ein unterschriebenes Exemplar innerhalb von 14 Werktagen ab dem Datum dieses Briefes zurück; mitgezählt werden Montag bis Samstag, nicht aber Sonntage und Feiertage.
items.computation: Letter date (Briefdatum) is Friday 04.07.2025. The period runs 'ab dem Datum dieses Briefes' (from the date of the letter); applying the default rule of § 187 Abs. 1 BGB for periods triggered by an event, the day of the event (04.07.2025) is not counted and the period begins the next day, Saturday 05.07.2025. 'Werktage' here is defined by the letter itself as Monday–Saturday, excluding Sundays and public holidays. Counting forward, counting Sat/Mon-Sat as working days and skipping Sundays: Sat 05.07 (1), Mon 07.07 (2), Tue 08.07 (3), Wed 09.07 (4), Thu 10.07 (5), Fri 11.07 (6), Sat 12.07 (7), Mon 14.07 (8), Tue 15.07 (9), Wed 16.07 (10), Thu 17.07 (11), Fri 18.07 (12), Sat 19.07 (13), Mon 21.07 (14). No NRW public holidays fall in this window. The 14th Werktag is Monday 21.07.2025, so the signed contract must reach the sender by that date.

warnings: The deadline calculation depends on whether the letter's phrase 'ab dem Datum dieses Briefes' includes the letter date itself as day 1 or excludes it per § 187 BGB default; if the letter date (04.07.2025, a Friday) is counted as day 1 instead, the 14th Werktag would fall on Saturday 19.07.2025 instead of Monday 21.07.2025 — confirm with the landlord if close to the deadline.
The letter warns that failure to return the contract in time results in the apartment being reallocated to the next member on the waiting list, so the exact deadline matters.
